evidence: Lewis & Short s.v. chīrographum: “pure Lat. manus (in good prose; freq. in Cic.)”

terms.gloss: one’s own handwriting; a handwritten document
evidence: Cic. Fam. 2.13.3: extrēma pāgella pupugit mē tuō chīrographō (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: The Greek word; Lewis & Short note that good prose says manus.
